components.name: Waitlist Button
components.description: The one lime primary action, with a precise-pointer hover and brief pressed state.
components.css: .ds-join { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.8rem; min-height:54px; padding:.8rem 1.1rem; border:0; border-radius:5px; background:var(--color-accent, #b8f53d); color:var(--color-accent-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Strichpunkt Sans Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:720; letter-spacing:-.02em; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) } .ds-join:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } .ds-join:active { transform:translateY(1px) } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-join:hover { background:var(--color-accent-hover, #a6e22d) } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-join { transition:none } }

components.name: Email Field
components.description: An explicitly labeled fresh-paper field with visible focus, error, and success borders.
components.html: <label class="ds-email-label" for="ds-email">Your email address</label><input class="ds-email" id="ds-email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
components.css: .ds-email-label { display:block; margin-bottom:.4rem; color:var(--color-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:650 } .ds-email { display:block; width:min(100%, 360px); height:54px; padding:.8rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-rule, #b7c1b0); border-radius:5px; background:var(--color-paper-bright, #fbfaf4); color:var(--color-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:1.05rem; caret-color:var(--color-focus, #246b56) } .ds-email::placeholder { color:var(--color-muted, #546359); opacity:1 } .ds-email:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } .ds-email[aria-invalid=true] { border-color:var(--color-error, #a12c24) } .ds-email[data-success=true] { border-color:var(--color-success, #216246) }

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: Heavy wordmark with a single underlined external app link.
components.html: ParkdexOpen the web app ↗
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1.5rem; min-height:88px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule, #b7c1b0); color:var(--color-ink, #142d27) } .ds-wordmark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.65rem; color:inherit; font-family:'Strichpunkt Sans Variable',sans-serif; font-size:1.9rem; font-weight:780; letter-spacing:-.04em; text-decoration:none } .ds-mark { width:35px; height:35px; color:var(--color-accent, #b8f53d) } .ds-trees { color:var(--color-ink, #142d27) } .ds-app-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:44px; color:inherit; font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.22em; white-space:nowrap } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-app-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px } }

components.name: Screenshot Choice
components.description: An underlined, touch-sized manual control for the screenshot viewer.
components.css: .ds-preview { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.3rem; min-height:44px; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.22em; cursor:pointer } .ds-preview:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } .ds-preview:active { color:var(--color-secondary, #40594e) } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-preview:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px } }

components.name: Screenshot Tab
components.description: A compact manual viewer selector whose pressed state gains fresh paper and a pencil border.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:.3rem; background:var(--color-paper, #f1f0e8) } .ds-tab { min-height:44px; padding:.65rem .7rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:5px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; cursor:pointer } .ds-tab[aria-pressed=true] { border-color:var(--color-secondary, #40594e); background:var(--color-paper-bright, #fbfaf4) } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-tab:hover { background:var(--color-paper-bright, #fbfaf4) } }

components.name: Privacy Disclosure
components.description: Native details control with an in-flow mobile explanation and a paper popover at tablet widths.
components.html:
About your email
Only one email when Android is ready. No newsletter.
components.css: .ds-privacy { position:relative; color:var(--color-muted, #546359); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.9rem } .ds-privacy summary { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.22em } .ds-privacy summary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } .ds-privacy-content { max-width:40ch; padding:0 0 1rem; line-height:1.5 } @media (min-width:40rem) { .ds-privacy-content { position:absolute; bottom:100%; right:0; min-width:310px; padding:1.5rem; border:1px solid var(--color-rule, #b7c1b0); border-radius:6px; background:var(--color-paper-bright, #fbfaf4); color:var(--color-secondary, #40594e) } }

narrative.overview:
Parkdex feels like a useful, personal field guide laid on a lightly textured paper desk. Dense green ink and a candid, heavy headline hold the page together; electric lime behaves like a single marker stroke, not an all-over theme. Real app captures supply the detail and proof.

The design draws its type, paper, handwriting, and material restraint from Nathan's portfolio. Screens sit in legible, neutral matte hardware. The composition stays compact on desktop, then allows a natural vertical reading order on smaller screens. Its few actions are direct and calm, with visible focus and form feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and ink carry the surface; lime marks the action and one phrase.
Bold, tightly spaced display type pairs with readable, warmer body type and occasional handwriting.
Real screenshots remain crisp and large enough to inspect, inside restrained matte devices.
Thin rules and tonal paper changes organize space; overlays appear only for deliberate inspection.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Keep lime scarce. It identifies a key phrase or action while green ink and paper do the rest.

rules.name: The Human Annotation Rule
rules.body: Handwriting adds a personal aside around actual product content; it does not carry form labels, navigation, or essential instructions.

rules.name: The Matte Hardware Rule
rules.body: Preserve a dark chassis and distinct bezel at the smallest shipped size. A light-facing edge can define the silhouette; decorative chrome gradients are outside this material language.

rules.name: The Direct Interaction Rule
rules.body: Product previews change only on a visitor's action. Preserve semantic controls, 44px touch targets, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.

dos: Do use real Parkdex captures at legible sizes and retain the matte chassis around any device mockup.
Do let paper, ink, rules, and spacing establish hierarchy before adding color or shadow.
Do keep the handwritten voice to short personal annotations and the practical copy in Ysabeau.
Do preserve explicit validation, loading, network error, success, and focus states for signup.
donts: Don't spread the lime accent across whole panels or replace the device shell with brand color.
Don't invent polished chrome, detailed branded hardware, or a decorative gradient around screenshots.
Don't auto-advance app captures or make core content depend on animation.
Don't clip a narrow viewport merely to force a one-screen layout.
